description: This source file implements a plugin radio factory loader that dynamically loads shared libraries, creates radio factory instances, and wraps them with additional management classes. It defines classes for handling dynamic libraries and radio sessions, and provides a function to load a plugin based on a driver name.

classes.name: dynamic_library_deleter
classes.description: A functor that closes a dynamic library handle when invoked.

classes.name: radio_dynamic_wrapper
classes.description: Wraps a radio session with a dynamic library handle, managing its lifetime.

classes.name: radio_factory_dynamic_wrapper
classes.description: Wraps a radio factory with a dynamic library handle, managing its lifetime.

methods.name: ocudu::create_plugin_radio_factory
methods.description: Creates and loads a radio factory plugin based on the driver name, using dynamic library loading.
